Quest name: Gods of Greece and Egypt (Chrono Quest - B.C.)
Quest location: Marseille Adventurers' Guild
Skill requirement: r6 Search, r8 Theology, ARA(Arabic)
Pre-requisite discovery: The Statue of Zeus discovery (from "Statue of the greatest Greek god" quest) + The Statue of Horus discovery (from "Egyptian god of the sky" quest)
